description: Live games, their settings and thresholds, games started and completed by outcome, deaths, game-loop health, movement intensity and, as the last (repeated) row, a per-player drill-down: 100 Hz acceleration against the warning and death lines. Replaces Game Quality, Game Analytics and Player Insights (#1427).

panels.title: Live Games
panels.description: Games whose loop is running, real (game_kind=primary, the menu's game) and shadow (headless agent games). game_active is 1 while a game runs; each game has its own series (game_id).

panels.title: Players (real game)
panels.description: Players alive and players in the real game. game_players_alive has no labels and only the real (primary) game sets it; shadow games never write it.

panels.title: Game Duration
panels.description: Elapsed time of each running game of the selected kind (game_duration_seconds, updated every second while the game runs).

panels.title: Live Games by Mode
panels.description: One line per live game: mode, kind and game id (game_current_mode is 1 while the game is live and removed when its loop ends, FR-041).

panels.title: Sensitivity
panels.description: Sensitivity level of each live game of the selected kind (0 = ultra slow ... 4 = ultra fast).

panels.title: Music Tempo
panels.description: Current music playback speed of each live game (1.0 = slow, 1.3 = fast).

panels.title: Effective Thresholds (Sensitivity + Music Speed)
panels.description: Game-wide warning and death thresholds after the tempo LERP, before per-player factors (sensitivity factor, handicap, shields).

panels.title: Music Tempo Over Time
panels.description: Music playback speed per live game (1.0 = slow, 1.3 = fast). A faster tempo lowers the thresholds.

panels.title: Games Started (5 min windows)
panels.description: Games started per 5 minutes, by mode and kind.

panels.title: Games by Mode (time range)
panels.description: Share of games started per mode over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Games by Outcome (time range)
panels.description: Completed games by outcome over the time range: winner and tie (JoustFFA's natural end), completed (a natural end of a mode that does not classify it yet), force_ended (ForceEndGame, preemption by a real game), error (the session published game_error: no gRPC clients, mode creation failed, or the game loop raised). The game.outcome span attribute, as the outcome label of games_completed_total (UC-020 BR-003, #1427).

panels.title: Player Deaths per Minute
panels.description: Deaths per minute by mode and kind (game_player_deaths_total: one per death on the shared kill path, respawn deaths included).

panels.title: Game Loop Update Rate
panels.description: Measured loop rate of each live game of the selected kind against the configured rate (game_current_update_frequency_hz: the process-wide game_loop.update_frequency_hz value, the same for every game). A running game keeps the rate it started with, so after a flag change the configured line moves before the games do.

panels.title: Game Loop Jitter (lower is better)
panels.description: Standard deviation of the last 60 frame times of each live game of the selected kind, in milliseconds (game_loop_jitter_ms, one series per game_id, removed when the game ends).

Share of frames within 1.5x the target frame time since the loop started, per live game of the selected kind (game_loop_frame_consistency_percent, one series per game_id; instant query, so ended games drop out).
panels.title: Frame Consistency

panels.description: Latest frame-time standard deviation (ms) per live game of the selected kind (instant query, so ended games drop out).
panels.title: Frame Jitter

panels.description: Frames that took more than twice the target frame time, last 5 minutes, all modes. Ignores $game_kind: game_loop_frames_dropped_total only has a mode label, so real and shadow games are counted together.
panels.title: Dropped Frames (5m)

panels.description: Average current acceleration magnitude over all players in live games (g).
panels.title: Game Intensity
Peak Acceleration (per game)
panels.description: Highest acceleration magnitude per player in the current game (g).

panels.title: Near-Death Events per Minute
panels.description: Near-death events per minute (raw acceleration over the death threshold but the EMA saved the player). Counted at game end, so they show as a spike after each game.

panels.title: Warning Events per Minute
panels.description: Death warnings per minute per player.

panels.title: Movement Zone Distribution (time range)
panels.description: Share of acceleration samples per movement zone over the time range, all modes (game_accel_distribution buckets 1.1, 1.5 and 2.0 g).

panels.title: Analytics Samples (time range)
panels.description: Analytics samples recorded over the time range.

panels.title: Near-Death Events (time range)
panels.description: Near-death events over the time range.

panels.title: Warning Events (time range)
panels.description: Death warnings over the time range.
Real-time acceleration gauge with warning (yellow) and death (red) zones
panels.title: Acceleration
